data.long_meaning: Anang is a Sanskrit name that means 'nourisher', 'supporter'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anang', which means 'without hunger'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to bring happiness, prosperity, and success to his or her family. The name Anang carries the meaning “Nourisher, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anang usually hope their child will grow to embody nourisher, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
